trial_accounting.note: Main-grid points (A 40 incl. 2 exploratory baskets, B 24 incl. 3 extra baskets) and the full A/B robustness grid (3,825 versions) are all counted; selection used only the main grid.

dsr.method: Bailey-LdP 2014 via open_composer.research.scorecard_v2.dsr; var_SR = cross-point variance of annual recent net Sharpe within the group; N_eff = 1+(N-1)(1-mean pairwise corr) per group, summed across groups with C and D counted as independent points

power.reading: recent window alone cannot confirm a Sharpe below ~1.5; QQQ A anchor (Sharpe 1.14) t_NW=1.94
